dialogs.about: 친구 부부가 오기 전에 할아버지와 다과를 준비해요

lines.en: Our friends will come at three.
Good. Did you make the refreshments?
Yes, I made cookies this morning.
Where are the slippers for the guests?
Beside the door. Please put them out.
Done. Should I fill the teapot?
Yes, please. Put it on the tray.
lines.ko: 네, 부탁해요. 쟁반 위에 놓아 주세요.

lines.en: The doorbell is ringing! They are here.
Let's welcome them. You are a good host.
Thank you. I will bring the napkins.
Hello! I rang your doorbell a minute ago.
Welcome! Did you wait long outside?
No, not at all. Thank you for these slippers.
Sit here. Would you like some tea?
Yes, please. Your teapot is beautiful.
My daughter gave it to me last year.
Can I help you with the dishes?
No, you are my guest today. Please rest.
You treat me so well. Thank you.
I will give you some leftovers later.
